title: Love at long last: "It was just a fluke"
summary: In Bay City, Michigan, 65-year-old Al Sager and 76-year-old Susan Guc were both content with being single their whole lives – committed to being uncommitted – until they both underwent heart procedures and were placed in the same cardiac rehab program. Steve Hartman reports on how true love took the long way 'round, proving that it's never too late to find…
